before.name: Track license options are readable for approved tracks, owners,
before.using:
(is_admin() OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM tracks t
  WHERE ((t.id = track_license_options.track_id) AND (t.artist_user_id = auth.uid())))) OR (active AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM buyer_catalog_public t
  WHERE (t.id = track_license_options.track_id)))))

after.name: Track license options are readable for approved tracks, owners,
after.using:
(is_admin() OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM tracks
  WHERE ((tracks.id = track_license_options.track_id) AND (tracks.artist_user_id = auth.uid())))) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM tracks
  WHERE ((tracks.id = track_license_options.track_id) AND (tracks.status = 'approved'::track_status)))))

before.name: track_rights_holders_public
before.definition:
SELECT r.id,
    r.track_id,
    r.name,
    r.role_type,
    r.ownership_percent
   FROM (rights_holders r
     JOIN tracks t ON ((t.id = r.track_id)))
  WHERE ((t.status = 'approved'::track_status) AND (current_app_role() = ANY (ARRAY['buyer'::user_role, 'admin'::user_role])));

after.name: track_rights_holders_public
after.definition:
SELECT rights_holders.id,
    rights_holders.track_id,
    rights_holders.user_id,
    rights_holders.name,
    rights_holders.role_type,
    rights_holders.ownership_percent,
    rights_holders.approval_status,
    rights_holders.created_at,
    rights_holders.updated_at
   FROM (rights_holders
     JOIN tracks ON ((tracks.id = rights_holders.track_id)))
  WHERE (tracks.status = 'approved'::track_status);

limitations: Hosted internal storage tables/triggers excluded except application guard. New RPC EXECUTE grants compared for PUBLIC/anon/authenticated/service_role; provider owners/default grants remain an operational review item. No live mutations or runtime Storage/PostgREST requests.
